about: Milliseconds vitest reports for one of Pele's stress tests run alone on the JavaScript build, before (main at 390ae3c) and after this step, on the 4-core sandbox, 14 November 2026. Measured with timings.sh beside this file, on tests.tsv; run to run they vary by a tenth or so.

tests.test: venn worst cases 5,000 styles for one set
agentflow worst cases 3,000 flows that each name the next one
state diagram worst cases 8,000 description lines on one state
journey worst cases a title of 50,000 characters
timeline worst cases a title of 50,000 characters
worst cases edges that each cross 1,000 nested subgraph borders
worst cases 3,000 long edges over a chain of 3,000
mindmap worst cases label of emphasis markers
C4 worst cases a link wrapped in layers of entity encoding
class diagram worst cases 1,600 classDefs applied to 1,600 classes
gantt worst cases a custom format checked for every excluded day
